user.title: Connect to SolarEdge ONE
user.description: How do you want to connect?

menu_options.oauth: Site Access: sign in with SolarEdge (homeowners, OAuth 2.0)
menu_options.api_key: API key (Fleet Access or an existing key)

api_key.title: Connect with an API key
api_key.description: Enter your SolarEdge ONE API credentials. The API key is required; the account key is only needed for Fleet accounts.

data_description.plan_type: Choose 'Fleet' for a My Fleet token or 'Site owner' for a single-site token.

sign_in.title: Sign in with SolarEdge
sign_in.description:
Register this redirect URI on your SolarEdge Site Access app:

`{callback_url}`

SolarEdge only accepts **HTTPS** addresses on a real domain. If the one above is `http://` or an IP address, register the HTTPS address you reach Home Assistant at instead (for example via a reverse proxy or Home Assistant Cloud), followed by `/auth/solaredge_one/callback`. It only has to work from your browser.

Choose **Sign in automatically** to open SolarEdge and approve access. If the redirect can't reach Home Assistant, choose **Paste the redirect address**.

paste.title: Paste the redirect address
paste.description:
1. Open [the SolarEdge consent page]({authorize_url}) and approve access.
2. When SolarEdge sends the tab to your redirect URI (even if the page doesn't load), copy the full address from the address bar. It contains `code=`.
3. Paste it below. The code is single-use and expires quickly.

site.title: Select the site
site.description: Enter the numeric ID of the site you approved on the SolarEdge consent screen.

select_site.title: Select a site
select_site.description: Choose which site to add. Add the integration again to add more sites.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate SolarEdge ONE
reauth_confirm.description: Your credentials are no longer valid. Enter a new API key.

reauth_oauth.title: Re-authorize SolarEdge ONE
reauth_oauth.description: SolarEdge access for this site has expired or been revoked. Submit to sign in with SolarEdge and approve access again.

error.invalid_auth: Invalid authentication. Check your API key.
error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to SolarEdge. Try again.
error.oauth_failed: SolarEdge refused the authorization code. Sign in again and paste the new redirect address straight away (codes are single-use and expire quickly).
error.invalid_redirect_url: That address doesn't contain an authorization code (`code=`).
error.site_not_found: SolarEdge has no site with that ID.
error.site_not_authorized: This sign-in wasn't granted access to that site. Use the site ID you approved.

abort.no_sites: No new sites are available for this account.
abort.wrong_site: You authorized a different site than the one this entry is for.
abort.migrated_to_oauth: This site was already set up with an API key. It now uses Site Access instead, and its entities and history are kept.
abort.missing_configuration: No SolarEdge application credentials are configured. Add your Site Access Client ID and Client Secret under Settings > Devices & services > Application credentials.
abort.missing_credentials: No SolarEdge application credentials are configured. Add your Site Access Client ID and Client Secret first.
abort.oauth_implementation_unavailable: The SolarEdge application credentials are unavailable.
abort.authorize_url_timeout: Timed out generating the SolarEdge sign-in address.
abort.no_url_available: No Home Assistant URL is available. Configure one: {docs_url}

application_credentials.description:
Create a **Site Access** app with the Monitoring service on the [SolarEdge Developer Platform]({developer_portal_url}) and register this redirect URI:

`{redirect_url}`

SolarEdge only accepts HTTPS addresses on a real domain. If the one above is `http://` or an IP address, use the HTTPS address you reach Home Assistant at instead, followed by `/auth/solaredge_one/callback`.

Then enter the app's Client ID and Client Secret here.

init.title: Rate limiting & credit budget
init.description: Control how often SolarEdge ONE is polled so you stay within your plan's monthly credits and per-minute call limit.

data_description.monthly_credit_budget: Total API credits your plan allows per month (My Fleet default: 2000).
data_description.calls_per_minute: Maximum API calls per minute your plan allows (default: 10).
data_description.budget_safety_factor: Fraction of the monthly budget to actually spend, leaving headroom (default: 0.7).

over_budget.title: SolarEdge ONE credit budget may be exceeded
over_budget.description: At the current polling rate this site is projected to use about {projected} API credits this month, above your budget of {budget}. Polling has been slowed automatically. Increase the budget or reduce enabled data in the integration options if this is unexpected.
